name: smstunnel
description: Send texts from your computer through your own Android phone and number, with SMSTunnel. Sign-in codes, status, received texts and usage from the command line. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit/args.test.mjs test/unit/numbers.test.mjs test/unit/sign-in-code.test.mjs test/unit/sms-parts.test.mjs test/unit/errors.test.mjs test/unit/store.test.mjs test/unit/time.test.mjs test/unit/format.test.mjs test/unit/idempotency-key.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
